text:
sam: Quick flag — we just hit a customer report where quota usage showed up under the org rather than the project. looks like auth-proxy fallback is attributing to org_id when key-level claim missing :facepalm:

maria: Ugh. Do you have a repro or a raw header dump?

sam: Pasted example from ngrep — request went through the proxy and the original x-project-id header was dropped. proxy then called authz with only api_key -> service_account mapping which returns org_id only.

sam: ```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-Api-Key: sa_ABC123
X-Region: us-west-2
```

maria: That explains it. We currently call /auth/lookup which returns {service_account_id, org_id, projects: []} unless the token was created with project binding. proxy logic says: if projects empty -> attribute to org.

olivia: Proposal: change fallback to "attribute to service_account if project absent" for quota counting and billing, but keep console view as org-level unless we can resolve project later. That way per-key spend is visible and quota is enforced per-SA.

aj: Question — how do we handle downstream routing? some routing policies rely on project affinity for placement/quotas. If we attribute to SA only, routing might pick wrong capacity pool.

kevin: We can embed an effective_project claim in the authz response after a best-effort resolution (lookup recent project usage or console default). Add a near-term config flag: auth_proxy.use_sa_fallback = true.

maria: Telemetry note: we need a metric for "attribution_fallback" with tags {reason: dropped_header|no_project_binding|migrated_key}. Add sampling at 100% for 48h during rollout.

sam: UX ask: console should show "Effective attribution" column with a tooltip: "How this request was billed/quotad — may differ from original headers if proxy or key omitted project binding." Small red badge if fallback used.

olivia: Rollout plan draft: 
- stage 1 (canary): enable use_sa_fallback=true for 1% of traffic and edit dashboards to surface attribution_fallback metric.
- stage 2 (ramp): 25% traffic, collect 48h of telemetry, verify no quota double-counting.
- stage 3: 100% and flip console to show SA attribution.

deploy-bot: deploy auth-proxy v2.14.0-canary to us-west-2 (canary=1%) — started at 2026-03-20T10:12:00Z

aj: Testing checklist: unit tests for lookup fallback, e2e with proxy dropping X-Project-Id, integration test ensuring routing decision still honors project hint when available.

kevin: I'll add a short migration script to retroactively re-attribute last-30d tokens for keys that had project binding in the DB but dropped in the request (best-effort). Won't touch billing rows until legal ok.

maria: Action items: @kevin add metric + migration PR, @aj tests + integration, @olivia console tooltip & column, @sam run the canary watch tomorrow 9am PT.

sam: Thanks — launching the canary now. will post results in #eng-platform-canary after 4h. :rocket:
